name: Korean nationalism
summary: Korean nationalism centres on the minjok, an ethnic nation of shared blood, culture and history traced to the legendary founder Dangun. It arose as resistance to Japanese colonial rule and great-power domination, and it aims at a sovereign, ideally reunified, Korean nation. Its strands include ethnic minjok nationalism (more common on the anti-imperialist left and in the democracy movement) and state nationalism tied to the ROK or DPRK.
scope: The mainstream modern minjok nationalism of Korea from the early 20th-century historiography of Shin Chae-ho and the independence movement through South Korean ethnic and state nationalism. It treats Shin's anarchist turn, the North Korean Juche fusion of ethnicity and one-party rule, and the recent decline of reunification sentiment as variants rather than the core. Economic and social questions are mostly outside the ideology and are answered with low confidence.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Korean nationalism has no healthcare doctrine; a state-guaranteed system fits the nation-as-one-family framing and South Korea's own national insurance, so a mild inferred yes.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Not a nationalist issue as such; inferred from the opposition to economic exploitation in Shin's declaration, hence mild agreement.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Nationalists range from state-led developmentalists (Park Chung-hee) to anti-chaebol left nationalists, so no common answer.

public-ownership.rationale: No settled view: the state-nationalist right favored state-directed industry while the minjok left leaned toward public control, so adherents split.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Inferred from the declaration's attack on privileged classes and economic exploitation; the ideology itself sets no tax program.

unions-good.rationale: The democracy movement of the 1980s was cast as ethnic nationalism against authoritarian rule and the declaration puts the masses at the center, so labor is mildly welcomed.

property-fundamental.rationale: Nationalism is indifferent to property doctrine; right-leaning state nationalists would agree and left nationalists would not.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Inferred from opposition to economic exploitation and privilege; the nationalist literature does not address corporate regulation directly.

cut-welfare.rationale: Solidarity of the whole minjok makes cutting welfare for fellow nationals uncongenial, though the ideology has no welfare program.

worker-ownership.rationale: Not addressed by nationalism; left strands might like it, conservative strands would not.

surveillance-ok.rationale: State nationalism backed security-state measures against the North, while ethnic nationalism opposed authoritarian regimes, so adherents split.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Inferred from socially conservative, culture-preserving orientation; not a stated position.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Shin warns ethnic nationalism fused with racism is dangerous, but nationalism itself offers no speech doctrine.

strong-leader.rationale: State nationalism served strongmen like Rhee and Park, while ethnic nationalism was also the language of anti-authoritarian movements.

state-harmful.rationale: Korean nationalism aims at a sovereign nation-state and even at reunifying two states, so the idea that the state is unnecessary is rejected.

limit-guns.rationale: Inferred; guns are not an issue in Korean nationalism and strict control is the national norm.

empower-police-military.rationale: Inferred from national-security concerns toward the North and Japan; but ethnic nationalists also resisted authoritarian security forces.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Inferred from a culture-protecting, conservative orientation; not a stated position.

decide-locally.rationale: The nation as one indivisible minjok favors national-level unity over localism; inferred.

rehabilitation.rationale: No stated criminal-justice doctrine; adherents are not united.

traditional-family.rationale: Inferred from emphasis on lineage and culture; Shin's own Neo-Confucian education points the same way.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Inferred from the culture-preserving, descent-centered orientation; not a stated position.

abortion-legal.rationale: Not addressed by Korean nationalism, and adherents divide on it.

more-religion-public.rationale: Nationalism is defined by ethnicity and descent, not religion; Dangun reverence is cultural, so no clear stance.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Korean nationalism addresses colonial injustice by Japan rather than racial injustice in the Western sense; not applicable.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Inferred from a traditionalist leaning; nationalism itself is silent.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Modern Korean nationalism took shape under Japanese rule precisely to protect Korean culture, history and identity.

gradual-change.rationale: Anti-colonial nationalism was a revolutionary and insurgent project that rejected waiting, though mainstream post-war nationalism is institutional.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Ethnic-descent nationhood favors limiting newcomers, though economic need and a multiethnic reality complicate it.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Hostility to great-power domination and emphasis on sovereignty make strengthening supranational bodies unattractive; inferred.

free-trade.rationale: No doctrine; the developmentalist state nationalist right was export-oriented, others protectionist.

nation-first.rationale: Putting the minjok and its sovereignty first is the core of the ideology, though Korean nationalism is mainly defensive rather than isolationist.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Not addressed; anti-imperialist suspicion of great-power intervention competes with South Korea's alliance practice.

open-borders.rationale: A nation defined by shared blood makes open borders contrary to the ideology, per Shin's account of descent-based citizenship.

limit-growth.rationale: Inferred from national pride in technology and development.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Younger nationalists take pride in technological innovation, suggesting mild optimism; inferred.

expand-nuclear.rationale: No nationalist doctrine; energy self-sufficiency and security concerns pull both ways.

revolution-justified.rationale: Shin's declaration calls violence the weapon of revolution against foreign rule; mainstream nationalism accepts armed resistance to colonialism but also nonviolent protest.

experts-over-public.rationale: The declaration makes the masses the headquarters of revolution; inferred populist leaning.

central-planning.rationale: Not a nationalist position; developmentalist state nationalism used state direction within a market economy.

socialized-markets.rationale: Not addressed; adherents split by left and right.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Inferred from sovereignty and economic self-assertion, and South Korea's own protective developmental history.

state-directs-investment.rationale: State nationalism under Park Chung-hee tied national strength to state-led industrialization.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Not addressed; opposition to exploitation does not specify a property pattern.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Not a nationalist aim; Shin's anarchism is outside the mainstream.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State nationalism favored state-coordinated economy but ethnic nationalism has no such doctrine.

one-party-rule.rationale: South Korean nationalism is democratic in its mainstream, though North Korea's Juche state fuses ethnicity with one-party rule.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Shin's declaration targets privileged classes and 'servile' thought, and modern Korean nationalism is republican.

democracy-best.rationale: Younger South Koreans draw national pride from democratic institutions and 1980s nationalism opposed authoritarianism, but state nationalism accommodated dictators.

right-to-secede.rationale: Nationalism favors a unified minjok and state, so secession is disfavored; inferred.

natural-rulers.rationale: Shin explicitly condemns privileged classes and the idea that heroes or elites should lead; the masses make the revolution.

political-violence-never.rationale: Armed resistance to colonial rule is honored, but the 1919 independence movement was largely nonviolent.

war-builds-character.rationale: The national experience of colonial rule, war and division is framed as suffering, not ennobling; inferred.

separate-church-state.rationale: The nation is defined by descent not faith, so religion is not a national institution; inferred.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Not a feature of Korean nationalism, which is ethnic and secular in form.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Nationalism centers on the sovereign state, making privatized defense incompatible; inferred.

military-superiority.rationale: Security rivalry with North Korea and Japan makes a strong military favored; inferred.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Ethnic nationalism rests on the belief that Koreans are a nation of shared blood and ancestry, and Shin treats the minjok as the foundation of history.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Shin made the minjok and its struggle against others, not class, the center of history; mainstream nationalism puts nation above class.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Anti-Japanese sentiment centers on colonial cruelty, comfort women and compensation grievances, so Korean nationalists press the principle strongly.

civilizational-union.rationale: Shin rejected subordination to Chinese or Japanese influence; a pan-civilizational union is not a Korean nationalist aim.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Collective identity is prized over individual self-interest; inferred.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Shin notes ethnic nationalism subordinated individual rights to the collective.

limit-population.rationale: Nationalists worry about the nation's size and decline rather than overpopulation; inferred.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: National pride in modernization makes this unlikely.

accelerate-technology.rationale: No stated doctrine on disruptive change.

human-enhancement.rationale: Korean nationalist sources say nothing on bodily enhancement, so adherents have no shared view.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Encryption policy is outside the concerns of Korean nationalist writing; no common position.

restore-past-order.rationale: Shin rejects privileged class and servile traditions; the goal is national restoration, not old social order.

results-over-ideology.rationale: The ideology has no stance on pragmatism versus doctrine in policymaking.

direct-action.rationale: Shin's declaration advocates direct revolution; mainstream nationalists use elections and diplomacy, so split.

means-match-ends.rationale: Shin holds destruction and construction are inseparable, but the mainstream has no view.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Contrary to national pride in development; inferred.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Shin condemns economic exploitation, but mainstream nationalism takes no stand on profit theory.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Class dictatorship contradicts a nation-first framework; inferred.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Not a nationalist doctrine; anti-imperialism targets great powers not capitalism as such.

taxation-theft.rationale: Contradicts national solidarity and state-building; inferred.

harm-principle.rationale: Limits on state power over private conduct are not a topic in minjok nationalism; left neutral.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Shin documents ethnic nationalism placing the collective above individual rights.

conscription.rationale: South Korean national defense relies on conscription, and the 2011 enlistment oath change shows military service is tied to national identity.

exit-over-voice.rationale: The ideology binds the individual to the nation; inferred.

state-as-business.rationale: Inferred; the nation is not a firm and citizens are not customers.

positive-liberty.rationale: The ideology's freedom concern is national independence, not material capability, so it is neutral here.

media-academia-power.rationale: Nationalists did criticize colonial scholarship, but no doctrine on media and universities' power exists.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Shin notes Koreans did not clearly distinguish ethnicity from race, but this audit finds no doctrine on genetic ability differences.

organic-representation.rationale: Not a feature of Korean nationalism.

total-state.rationale: State nationalism drew on Showa statism but total control of life is not a mainstream nationalist demand.

national-rebirth.rationale: Anti-colonial nationalism sought to revive the nation from subjugation, though 'decadence' framing is not stated.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Shin's claims about lost northern lands are historiographic and mainstream nationalism is not expansionist.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Opposed to privileged classes and hierarchical servility; inferred.

bound-labor.rationale: Contrary to the declaration's opposition to privilege and exploitation.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Nationalist historiography treats Japanese colonial history as politically motivated, but the ideology has no epistemology.

universal-morality.rationale: Korean nationalism does not take a position on moral universalism; neutral.

single-common-good.rationale: Nationalism speaks of one people, but has no theory of a rationally determined common good; neutral.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: No Korean nationalist position; inferred indifferent.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Descent-based citizenship lets overseas Koreans regain citizenship more easily than migrants.

revive-national-language.rationale: Korean was never lost, but Shin stressed preserving Hangul as part of identity; applying it to a lapsed language is inferred.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Corporate governance is not addressed by Korean nationalist sources.

school-vouchers.rationale: School funding mechanisms are unrelated to the ideology; neutral.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Fiscal policy is not part of Korean nationalism; adherents differ by party.

economic-freedom.rationale: The ideology does not tie political freedom to economic freedom either way.

national-self-determination.rationale: Anti-colonial independence and resistance to foreign domination is the founding purpose of Korean nationalism.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Epistemology is not addressed; Korean nationalism draws on myth like Dangun but takes no stand against reason.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Descent-based national membership favors reserving benefits for nationals; inferred.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Welfare conditionality is not a nationalist issue; adherents split.

class-collaboration.rationale: Nation as one people overrides class lines; inferred.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Preserving the nation's culture and history is central, so sacrificing heritage institutions is rejected.

dominated-front.rationale: Nationalism is marked by anti-imperialism and hostility to great powers, but a common anti-Western front is not stated.

workers-nation.rationale: Nation takes precedence over class; inferred.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Gender roles are not addressed in the sources reviewed; left neutral.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Shin warns ethnic nationalism fused with racism is dangerous; segregation law is not a Korean nationalist demand.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Not addressed by mainstream nationalism; Shin has anarchist elements.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Energy production is not addressed by Korean nationalism; adherents differ.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: An ethnically defined nation, limited tolerance and blood-based citizenship imply expectation of assimilation.

elite-replacement.rationale: Not a Korean nationalist theme; inferred.

proportional-representation.rationale: Electoral system design is not a nationalist question.

national-mission.rationale: Korean nationalism is defensive and identity-preserving, not a missionary export of its system.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Inferred from traditionalism; nationalism is silent.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Hostility to privileged classes is in Shin, yet mainstream nationalism lends no common view.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Ethnic nationalism opposed authoritarian regimes in the 1980s democracy movement, suggesting support for accountability.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Nationalism expects the state to defend culture and the nation broadly; inferred.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Pure-blood ideology supports it traditionally, while Korea's multiethnic society and 2011 oath change show rejection, so adherents split.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Shin warns racist fusion is dangerous and tolerance has lagged, so abstract equal worth is agreed but ethnic hierarchy of membership persists.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Socialist strategy is outside Korean nationalism's concerns.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Settler colonialism is not a Korean nationalist topic; neutral.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Nation as one people favors common law; inferred.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Nation defined by ethnicity not faith; inferred.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist question not addressed by the nationalist mainstream.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Opposition to Japanese annexation rests on the people being ruled without consent; inferred.

population-transfer.rationale: Not a Korean nationalist aim; inferred.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Shin accepts violence against foreign rule; mainstream nationalists accept resisting colonial force.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Shin sees history as struggle of peoples, but the mainstream has no doctrine.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Not addressed; split by left and right.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Anti-domination was the aim of the independence cause; inferred.

separated-powers.rationale: Not addressed directly; democratic nationalists would accept it.

vanguard-party.rationale: The declaration says the masses themselves lead the revolution, not a vanguard.

priority-to-poor.rationale: The ideology gives no priority rule for the poor; adherents split.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Public housing sales are unrelated to Korean nationalist thought.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Strike law is not a nationalist issue; adherents split by left and right.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Ethnic homogeneity is treated as the basis of solidarity and Shin notes tolerance is limited.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: State nationalism justified emergency rule, while ethnic nationalists opposed authoritarianism; split.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Price control policy is not addressed by Korean nationalism.

party-commands-army.rationale: Not a nationalist position outside North Korea.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Shin notes citizenship by bloodline favors co-ethnics over immigrants.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Pay of legislators is not a topic in Korean nationalist sources.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Party organization is outside the ideology's concerns.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Sovereignty is central to the cause; inferred.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Constitutional command arrangements are not addressed; presidential command exists in South Korea but nationalism has no doctrine.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is not applicable to ethnic nationalism.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: The democracy-movement strand rejects entrenched rulers; inferred.

recall-officials.rationale: Recall of officials is not addressed by nationalist sources.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Left nationalists opposed US troops while conservative state nationalists backed the alliance, so split.

people-in-arms.rationale: Not a Korean nationalist position; conscription is the mainstream form.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: The ideology does not rank rural versus urban life; neutral.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Centrist minjok nationalists tried to prevent division in 1945-50 and the Sunshine Policy sought peaceful reunification; the minjok is one nation.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Not a nationalist theme; nationalist historians were themselves scholars.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Nationalists take pride in Korean culture but reject colonial hierarchy of civilizations; no firm view.

death-penalty.rationale: Capital punishment is not part of nationalist doctrine; adherents split.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Sex education is not an issue the sources link to Korean nationalism.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: South Korea uses jus sanguinis, which reinforces attachment to overseas Koreans, and a 2005 birthright proposal was dropped under public opinion.

minority-language-support.rationale: Nationalist sources focus on preserving Korean, not on minority languages; no stance.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Religious exemptions are not addressed; conscription disputes aside, the ideology is silent.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Shin notes ethnic nationalism limited cultural tolerance and liberalism.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: International debt policy is not addressed by Korean nationalist sources.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Shin's declaration lists economic exploitation and inequality as targets beyond foreign rule, though mainstream nationalism seldom says this.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Constitution-making procedure is not a nationalist doctrine.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: State nationalism justified authoritarian developmentalism while ethnic nationalism opposed it, so adherents split.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Global aid duties are not addressed by the ideology.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Not addressed by nationalist texts; adherents divide on the US umbrella.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: South Korea's democracy movement won direct presidential elections; inferred.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Central bank design is outside Korean nationalism.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: The Dokdo dispute is treated as symbolic of sovereignty with no compromise (Roh Moo-hyun), indicating reluctance to cede claimed homeland.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Property theory is not addressed; adherents split between left and right.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: The characterization of the USSR is not a nationalist question.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Environmental regulation is not addressed by Korean nationalism.

collective-defense.rationale: Conservative strands back the US alliance while left nationalists oppose it.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Shin's declaration frames Japan's 1910 annexation as foreign rule to be ended, and Koreans treat colonial rule as illegitimate.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Church-state power is not an ethnic-nationalist concern.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: The nation as one people favors a unifying head; inferred.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: No stated position; reunification, not secession, is the Korean nationalist concern.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Not addressed by nationalist sources; some reunification proposals envision it but this audit found no source.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Shin condemns privileged classes and servile thought; a divine ruler is rejected outside North Korea's leader cult.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Tax rate structure is not a nationalist issue.

character-from-environment.rationale: Nature-versus-nurture is not taken up by the nationalist sources reviewed.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Opposition to privilege and arbitrary rule; inferred.

space-expansion.rationale: Space policy is not addressed by Korean nationalism.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Classical constitutional theory is outside Korean nationalism.

leader-cult.rationale: North Korea has one but mainstream South Korean nationalism does not; inferred.

equal-parenting.rationale: Family law is not addressed by the ideology.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: A Marxist question not relevant to Korean nationalism; neutral.

land-redistribution.rationale: Not addressed; opposition to privilege suggests mild sympathy but no stated position.

refugee-return.rationale: Divided-family issues exist, but no stated doctrine.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Shin's historiography blurs Korea-Manchuria boundaries, but mainstream nationalism makes no such state claim.

common-currency.rationale: Monetary union is not addressed; sovereignty concerns and regional trade interests cut both ways.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Shin linked Koreans and Manchurians genealogically, yet nationalism's political aim is a Korean state.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Minority autonomy is not addressed in Korean nationalist sources.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: This diaspora-strategy question is not addressed by Korean nationalism.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Shin puts the minjok and its history at the center; inferred for mainstream.

ban-cartels.rationale: Inferred from opposition to concentrations of economic privilege; weakly tied to chaebol criticism.

no-bailouts.rationale: Bailout policy is not addressed by the ideology.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Court-majority relations are not a nationalist doctrine.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Gender quotas are not addressed by nationalist sources.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Trade standards are not addressed by the ideology.

moral-incentives.rationale: Incentive design is not a Korean nationalist topic.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Shin's declaration favors armed uprising but adherents are split on method.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: The declaration names a privileged class among the obstacles to be abolished.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Nationalist historiography (Shin's Doksa Sillon and Joseon Sanggosa) placed the nation's own history at the center.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Shin rejected Japanese claims that Korea was insignificant as a colonial agenda, and anti-colonial nationalism denies the tutelage argument.

patriotic-education.rationale: Nationalist identity was built around history, Dangun and national symbols, and the flag represents the ethnic nation for many.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Race-conscious admissions are a US issue not addressed by Korean nationalism.

public-money-creation.rationale: Monetary design is outside Korean nationalism.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Capitalist crisis theory is not part of the ideology.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Not a stated aim; Korean nationalism is anti-imperial.

delink-world-market.rationale: Not a nationalist aim given export-led development.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist thesis not addressed by Korean nationalism.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Democratic nationalists accept it, though rights vs collective tension exists.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: Koreans reject Japanese colonial rule as illegitimate; treaty voidness is inferred.

elective-rulers.rationale: Opposition to hereditary privilege implies election of rulers.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Ethnic nationalism opposed authoritarian regimes in the democracy movement.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Parliament versus executive is not a stated nationalist position.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Animal ethics is not addressed by Korean nationalism.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Animal use is not addressed by the ideology.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: The ideology offers no doctrine of elite duty; Shin criticizes privileged classes but not paternalism specifically.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Nationalism demands active commitment to the nation; inferred.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: A critical-theory claim not addressed by Korean nationalism.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Gramscian hegemony theory is not part of Korean nationalism.

native-born-offices.rationale: Nation membership by descent suggests priority for natives; inferred.

party-own-road.rationale: Communist party autonomy is not addressed by nationalist sources, though independence from outside powers is valued.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: North Korea's Juche stresses self-reliance, but South Korean nationalism accepts foreign investment.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Shin's historiography claims lost northern lands but mainstream politics does not demand it.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Not applicable to a nation that is not a settler state.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Constitutional anti-fascism is not stated in nationalist sources.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Totalitarianism comparisons are not addressed; adherents differ along North-South lines.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Colonial-era monuments and figures are contested heritage that nationalists want removed or reinterpreted; inferred.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Nationalists stress Korean uniqueness, yet sources give no view on Western institutions' fit.

military-guardian-role.rationale: The democracy movement opposed military rule.

filial-duty.rationale: Neo-Confucian education shaped early nationalists; inferred.

office-by-exam.rationale: Civil service selection is not addressed, though Confucian exam tradition is part of the heritage.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Sovereignty emphasis implies protection of strategic firms.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Divorce law is not addressed by Korean nationalism.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Delegate theory is a socialist concern not addressed by nationalist sources.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Pension design is not addressed by the ideology.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Land tenure theory is not addressed by Korean nationalism.

single-official-language.rationale: Shin held that preserving Hangul and Hanja was part of identity; one national language is natural.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: A US legal doctrine not addressed by Korean nationalism.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Consumer culture is not addressed by the ideology.

corporate-influence.rationale: Opposition to privilege and economic exploitation; inferred.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Concern for the nation's continuity favors it over immigration.

residents-only-property.rationale: Local property limits are not addressed by the ideology.

job-guarantee.rationale: Employment guarantees are not addressed by Korean nationalism.

democratic-peace.rationale: International-relations theory is not part of the ideology.

non-intervention.rationale: Anti-imperialist, anti-great-power outlook implies non-intervention; inferred.

industrial-unions.rationale: Union structure is not addressed by Korean nationalism.

local-production.rationale: Localism in production is not addressed; export-led growth dominates.

informal-organisation.rationale: Shin's anarchist organizing is atypical; mainstream nationalism is not defined by this.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Not addressed; sovereignty implies priority but adherents split.

religious-nation.rationale: The minjok is defined by descent and culture, not by religion.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Shin condemned servility toward China and Japan, and Korean nationalism is marked by hostility toward great powers.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: The unified-nation framing favors national sharing.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: A socialist formulation not addressed by Korean nationalist sources.

defeat-communism.rationale: State nationalism fused anti-communism with minjok under Rhee, while left minjok nationalism sought reconciliation with the North, so adherents split.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Public service delivery models are not addressed by the ideology.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: South Korean nationalism pursued export-led development and engagement with the world economy, so an autarkic bloc is not a nationalist aim; inferred.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Hostility to great-power domination and the colonial experience make intervention to hold an ally in a bloc unacceptable; inferred.

religion-illusion.rationale: Korean nationalism has no doctrine on religion; its minjok framing treats Dangun worship and Korean religious traditions as national heritage, so an illusion-fading view is not shared.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: No doctrine on capitalism; South Korean state nationalism credits state-led capitalist growth while the anti-imperialist left condemns it, so adherents split.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Gender economics is outside the ideology; Shin Chaeho-era anarchists and the left might agree but state nationalists would not.

socialized-care.rationale: Care policy is not a nationalist issue; inferred from the split between welfare-minded and market-minded strands.

purge-loanwords.rationale: North Korea purges loanwords officially and South Korean nationalists promote native Korean words over foreign ones, but this is not central, so a mild inferred yes.

treaties-binding.rationale: The ideology has not addressed such treaties; Korea has no comparable internal-nation treaties, so no stance can be inferred.

cooperative-communities.rationale: The ideology is organised around the nation-state, so reorganising society into small property-holding communes runs against it; inferred from its framing.

majority-settlement.rationale: Its ethnic-minjok framing stresses homogeneity, but the source on multiethnic Korea suggests no state-led settlement programme; inferred as a mild no.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: The division of Korea made both capitalism and communism contested; Shin Chaeho and the DPRK Juche claim a third path while most South Korean nationalists do not, so strands split.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Nationalist historiography roots Korea in Dangun and Gojoseon, and the movement presses the Dokdo claim on historical grounds.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from the movement's anti-colonial moral stance against atrocity and its demand for historical accountability.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: The movement has no doctrine here; the liberal minjok left and conservative state nationalists differ, so inferred as split.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Inferred from nationalism's roots in the democracy movement and Shin's hostility to privilege; the North Korean variant is excluded by scope.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from a secular, ethnic rather than religious definition of the nation.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Korean nationalism arose against Japanese colonial rule, and Shin's Declaration condemns foreign rule and exploitation of the people.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: An Islamic doctrine outside this tradition; inferred only from its support for resisting foreign invasion in general, not from religious law.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Not addressed; the nation rather than religion is the basis of legitimacy, so religious-law grounds for rebellion are not part of it.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Inferred from the democracy movement's alliance with minjok nationalism and Shin's call for popular revolution.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Not addressed; adherents focus on national rather than class or gender analysis, so inferred as indifferent.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Not addressed; conservative state nationalists and the liberal left are split.

assisted-dying.rationale: Not addressed by the movement; adherents are split.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Nationalism cuts across left and right in Korea, with left minjok and conservative state strands, so adherents are split.

alienated-labor.rationale: Shin's Declaration condemns exploitation, but the movement has no theory of alienation; adherents are split.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Not addressed; Western countries are not the movement's frame, and adherents are split on immigration.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Authority rests on the minjok and the people rather than God; inferred from the ethnic-national basis of the ideology.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Not addressed; Korea has no tradition of state religious dress disputes, so inferred as indifferent.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from the broad liberal-democratic mainstream of South Korean nationalism.

social-market-economy.rationale: Not a nationalist issue; inferred from South Korea's mixed economy with national insurance and from Shin's opposition to exploitation.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Shin's Declaration endorses armed revolutionary resistance to foreign rule, and the state strands defend the nation by arms.

rich-first.rationale: Left minjok nationalists criticised unbalanced growth while conservative state nationalists defended it; adherents are split.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Left nationalists favour autonomy and engagement while conservatives back the US alliance, so adherents are split.

dynastic-succession.rationale: The independence movement and Shin Chae-ho's republican, anarchist turn rejected hereditary rule; only the DPRK variant is dynastic, so a mild no inferred.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Not a nationalist issue; nothing in the minjok tradition addresses mutual banking.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Resistance to great-power domination suggests sympathy for refusing imposed conditions, though South Korea itself accepted IMF terms in 1997; inferred.

property-franchise.rationale: The movement is about the whole nation, so a wealth-based franchise cuts against it; inferred.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Not addressed by minjok nationalism; adherents are split.

reification.rationale: Not a nationalist theme; Shin's anarchism criticised exploitation but no source uses this concept.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Not addressed; the anti-colonial tradition fought censorship but did not frame press freedom through wealth.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Modern state nationalism sits within the ROK's constitutional legal order; inferred, since the ideology has no rule-of-law doctrine.

racial-franchise.rationale: Ethnic minjok belonging is central, but the source on multiethnic Korea shows mainstream nationalism is adapting to citizenship for non-ethnic Koreans; inferred.

online-participation.rationale: No stated position; adherents are not divided on it along nationalist lines.

open-government-data.rationale: Inferred from democratic-movement nationalism; no source states it.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Ethnic-community protectiveness might favour endogamy but religion is not a nationalist marker in Korea; inferred mild no.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Boycotting by religion has no place in minjok nationalism, which is ethnic rather than religious; inferred.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Not addressed; no documented nationalist position.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Religion is outside the ideology's concerns.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Inferred: minjok nationalism, especially its anti-imperialist and democratic strands, distrusts chaebol-style concentrations of power, but economics lies outside the core ideology.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Adherents are split: progressive minjok nationalists favour it, while conservative state nationalists stress traditional values; the sources do not address it.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Inferred: the ideology is anchored in the national founding myth and tradition, and promoting atheism is alien to it (the DPRK variant aside).

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Inferred: a nation-state ideology that values a sovereign state and its security forces rejects abolition of police and prisons.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Inferred: it favours a unitary ethnic nation governed by majority will and unification, not communal power sharing, though the sources do not discuss it.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Inferred: adherents are split between statist developmental views and community or family self-help; the sources do not address it.

term-limits.rationale: Inferred: not a nationalist issue; South Korea's single-term presidency exists but the ideology has no stated line on term limits.

vote-delegation.rationale: Inferred: unaddressed by the ideology and no settled adherent view.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: Inferred: not addressed; adherents focus on national survival and unification and are split on global priorities.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Adherents are split between Confucian and Christian traditionalists and progressive nationalists; the sources do not address it.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Inferred: Confucian tradition favoured husband authority, but modern South Korean law and progressive nationalists favour equality, so adherents are split.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Minjok nationalism defines the nation by common descent and blood, so full political membership, even local, is a contested extension; the multiethnic debate shows resistance.

rent-control.rationale: Not addressed by the sources; nationalists are split between developmentalist and egalitarian economics.

abolish-ip.rationale: Inferred from the strong developmental-state and national-competitiveness tradition of South Korean nationalism, which protects intellectual property.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Korean nationalism has a tradition of national-service and youth mobilisation, from the Hwarang myth to the Korea Youth Corps of the Rhee era, and conscription for all men.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Inferred from the strand's opposition to foreign interference and the independence movement's goals; nationalist opinion on US nuclear weapons in Korea is split.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Anti-foreign-domination nationalism opposes foreign troops on Korean soil, a recurring demand of nationalist movements concerning US bases.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Korean nationalism is organised around Japanese colonial wrongs and demands formal recognition of atrocities such as forced labour and the comfort women.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Not addressed by sources; nationalists are split between developmental and egalitarian economics, and Shin Chaeho's Declaration condemns exploitation and privilege.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: The Declaration of the Korean Revolution endorses revolutionary violence against Japanese rule, and the independence tradition honours armed resistance.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Shin Chaeho's historiography traces the minjok to Dangun and treats the Korean people as one unbroken line from antiquity.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Not addressed; the ethnic-descent view treats sex differences as natural, and the constructionist claim is foreign to the sources read.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Not addressed; nationalism treats national identity as primary over group divisions, so a politics split by categories of women is not favoured.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Korean nationalism honours independence martyrs, such as Yu Gwan-sun and An Jung-geun, and the national cemetery system; martyrdom of the nation is central.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Mainstream Korean nationalism is secular and historical; the spiritual-war framing is not described in the sources read.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Korean nationalism favours reunification and a single national state for all Koreans rather than a diaspora centre.

culture-before-state.rationale: The independence movement put the state first: liberation and independence were prerequisites; Shin Chaeho's history aimed at building national consciousness for that struggle.

god-not-male.rationale: Not addressed; adherents' views depend on religion and are split between Christians, Buddhists and secular nationalists.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Not addressed; no documented position among adherents.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Ethnic minjok nationalism holds the nation as a blood community and the scholarship shows resistance to multiethnic participation in national life.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Reunification of the divided peninsula into a single Korean state is a central aim of minjok nationalism.

independent-unions.rationale: Not part of the ideology; the strands split between state-run and independent unions.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Inferred: the core is ethnic and state nationalism whose unit is the nation, not the working class.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Inferred from the nation-as-one-family framing, which favours public provision of common needs.

second-chamber.rationale: Inferred: the nationalism aims at a single unified national state; the ROK has a single directly elected chamber.

municipal-property.rationale: Inferred: the ideology centres on the nation and its state, not on local community ownership.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Inferred: the ideology's unit is the unified nation, and Shin Chae-ho's anarchism is treated as a variant.

family-wage.rationale: Inferred from the family-centred, Confucian-influenced picture of the nation.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: Outside the ideology; no principle bears on it.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Inferred: investment in the nation's people and its ageing population fits the national-strength framing.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Outside the ideology; no principle bears on it.

online-anonymity.rationale: Outside the ideology; no principle bears on it.

person-over-state.rationale: Inferred: minjok nationalism puts the collective nation ahead of the individual, though Shin's anarchist turn dissents.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Inferred from the Dangun founding myth and traditional culture that minjok nationalism treats as central.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Inferred: the strands aim at a unified sovereign nation-state, so regional powers would be the centre's to grant.

gm-crops.rationale: Outside the ideology; no principle bears on it.

dense-cities.rationale: Outside the ideology; no principle bears on it.

racial-group-interests.rationale: The minjok is an ethnic nation of shared blood, and the nationalism asks Koreans to organise around the interests of that group.

racial-pride.rationale: Pride in shared blood, culture and history is the core of minjok nationalism.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Inferred: the nationalism arose as resistance to colonial rule and stresses sovereignty and self-defence.

language-defines-nation.rationale: The minjok is defined by shared blood, language, culture and history, and the nation is held to be one across the DMZ and the diaspora.

communal-electorates.rationale: Inferred from the ideal of one undivided minjok; separate religious electorates would split the nation, and the sources never discuss them.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Korean nationalism grew as resistance to colonial and great-power domination, and the division of Korea is widely blamed on outside powers.

free-public-college.rationale: Not an issue for the ideology; nationalists of left and right split, so no direction is inferred.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Environmental taxation lies outside the ideology and adherents are split by left and right strands.

future-generations.rationale: Inferred from the minjok's long-lived, descent-based view of the nation as a continuing community; the sources do not discuss the environment.

women-distinct-values.rationale: The ideology has no settled view; Shin's anarchist strand stressed equality while state nationalism leaned traditional.

arms-reduction.rationale: Inferred from a nationalism formed under foreign threat that prizes national defence, though reunification strands favour de-escalation.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Inferred from opposition to unequal treaties and great-power deals made over Korea's head; the sources give no explicit doctrine.

capital-controls.rationale: Economic questions are mostly outside the ideology and its strands diverge, from DPRK state control to ROK developmentalism.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Inferred: nationalists back a sovereign state with a national army, and the independence movement's armed bands were disbanded into the ROK's forces after 1948.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Inferred from the nationalism's stress on defending the nation; conscription is accepted in both Koreas, and refusal is seen as disloyal.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Economic questions lie outside the ideology; left minjok nationalists back unions, while state nationalists favoured developmental control of labour.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Outside the ideology; no consistent stance across its left and state strands.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Outside the ideology; no consistent stance across its strands.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Inferred from anti-imperialist resistance to great-power domination, which the left-leaning strand extends to the economic order.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Mainstream Korean nationalism seeks to build and capture a sovereign state; Shin Chaeho's anarchist turn is treated as a variant, so only mild disagreement.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: Inferred from the aim of a unified national state with one economic order; Shin's anarchism is a minority variant.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Outside the ideology; no stance among its strands.

sacred-nation.rationale: Minjok nationalism treats the nation as a community of shared blood traced to Dangun that endures across generations, a near-sacred bond.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Outside the ideology; no stance among its strands.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Not a concept of Korean nationalism; regional disparity (for example Honam) is discussed in politics but the ideology is about the whole nation, so neutral.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Minjok nationalism stresses the particular nation over universal human nature and does not address it directly.

public-service-media.rationale: Inferred from nationalism's use of national broadcasters such as KBS and MBC; the stance is not stated in the sources.

religions-one-truth.rationale: Not part of the doctrine; minjok nationalism is about the nation, and Korean nationalists span several religions, so no clear answer is inferred.

farm-price-support.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from the nation-as-one-family framing and the state's protective role for the rural population.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Inferred from state nationalism's emphasis on sovereignty and security against great-power pressure, though there is no unified doctrine.

workers-own-party.rationale: Minjok nationalism puts the whole nation above class divisions, so a separate class party is inferred as secondary to national unity.

ban-fgm.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from mainstream South Korean legal reforms and a modernising state, with little nationalist objection.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from South Korea's modern equalisation of inheritance rights and the nation's need for all members' participation.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Inferred from the minjok idea of one people and one language across both Koreas, which treats North and South varieties as the same Korean language.

pollution-tort-liability.rationale: Economic and legal doctrine are outside the ideology; inferred as favouring state regulation over private lawsuits.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Inferred from the modern, state-centred nation and Shin Chaeho's hostility to privilege and hereditary authority.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Not addressed; mainstream state nationalism has prioritised growth, with no clear stance on trading liberty for the environment.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Inferred from the strong-state and order orientation of ROK and DPRK state nationalism, though outside the doctrine.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Inferred from the ethnic definition of the nation and its expectation that newcomers assimilate, as Shin describes of multiethnic tensions.

no-compulsory-union.rationale: Korean nationalism has no labour doctrine, and its left and right strands split on unions, so this is left neutral.

voter-id.rationale: The ideology does not address voting procedure and its strands differ; no position can be inferred.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Nationalism here is ethnic rather than religious and has no stated position on interpretations of religion; strands differ.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: The democracy movement and the DPRK state strand give opposite answers, so adherents are split.

premarital-sex.rationale: Minjok nationalism's family-centred and Confucian-tinged traditionalism makes acceptance unlikely, inferred rather than stated in the sources.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: No doctrine on this; the South Korean state strand and the DPRK strand would differ.

negative-income-tax.rationale: Economic questions lie outside the ideology, as the scope says; no position can be inferred.

women-suffrage.rationale: Not a stated nationalist issue, but mainstream adherents accept equal political rights; inferred from the modern South Korean state.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: The nationalism centres on ethnicity and does not blame religion for women's position; a mild inferred disagreement.

race-social-construct.rationale: Minjok nationalism holds that the Korean nation is a unit of shared blood and descent, the opposite of treating racial categories as social constructs, as the multiethnic-society source describes.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: The ideology has no stance on gender policy and its strands differ.

homestead-ownership.rationale: Minjok nationalism has no doctrine on first-possession land claims; no position can be inferred.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: Inferred from the movement's resistance to Japanese colonial rule and grievance over its wrongs; accountability for aggression fits, though the sources do not discuss international courts.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Inferred from the secular, anti-colonial character of Shin Chae-ho's nationalism, which is built on shared descent and history rather than scripture.

gendered-self-government.rationale: Inferred from the democratic and anti-imperialist strands of minjok nationalism; the sources do not discuss gender in self-government.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Mainstream South Korean nationalism is anti-DPRK, so defending a planned state is rejected; the North Korean Juche strand would differ.

indirect-election.rationale: Inferred from the democracy movement, which fought for direct popular election of the president; the sources do not address indirect election.

national-church-status.rationale: Korea has no national church, and minjok identity rests on descent and history, so a privileged church is inferred to be rejected.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: The ideology stresses a single ethnic nation, and the source describes multiethnic society as a challenge to it; minority autonomy is inferred to be unwelcome.

disputed-territory-plebiscite.rationale: Inferred from the non-negotiable claim to islets such as Dokdo; the sources do not describe a plebiscite position.

keep-colonial-borders.rationale: Korea was not a colonial-border successor state in the usual sense, and the sources give no position.

simple-living.rationale: Economic and lifestyle questions are outside the ideology; no position can be inferred.

restrict-indigenous-settlement.rationale: Adherents are split between ethnic protectiveness and openness; the sources do not address settlement restrictions for indigenous peoples.

equal-conscription.rationale: South Korea conscripts men only and mainstream nationalism backs that arrangement; inferred, the sources do not discuss it.

missingStatements.text: A nation's identity should rest on shared descent from a founding ancestor.
missingStatements.rationale: Korean nationalism traces the minjok to Dangun, and Shin Chaeho's historiography proclaimed Koreans his descendants.

missingStatements.text: Governments should officially protest foreign textbooks and shrines that downplay their country's colonial-era wrongs.
missingStatements.rationale: Textbook disputes, Yasukuni visits and comfort-women issues are core grievances of South Korean nationalism.
missingStatements.declined: Narrow to one dispute (foreign textbooks and shrines); the bank already covers national history, memory and accountability through broader statements.

notes: Left minjok nationalism (anti-imperialist, pro-engagement with the North) and conservative state nationalism (anti-communist, pro-US-alliance) split on alliance, security and economic questions. Many answers are low-confidence inferences because the ideology is mostly about nationhood, not policy.
